video.title: Video Studio
video.start.title: Open a video file
video.start.body: MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV. Edits are non-destructive; your original file is never changed.
video.start.drop: Or drop a file anywhere in the window.
video.noPreview: This browser cannot play {ext}; probing and export still work.
video.format.mp4NoAudio: MP4 (H.264, silent: no AAC encoder on this platform)
video.exportHint: Encode the timeline and download it
video.untouched: No edits yet. You are watching the original.
video.note: Edits are encoded in a background worker. The original file is not changed.
video.splitHint: Split the clip under the playhead in two (S)
video.timelineHint: Clips play back to back. Drag a clip to reorder it; drag the edges of the selected clip to trim it. Keys: S split, Delete remove, Alt+←/→ move, M mute.
video.clipMute: Mute this clip in the export
video.clipHint: Trim range and gain apply to this clip only; the original file is never changed.
